item.title: I went to the Woods: Turning the noise off
item.description: The podcast ended just about as I was ready to drop anchor. I took out my earbuds, took the raft off the top of our new boat, filled it with three bags of concrete, my chainsaw, lunch, and building materials and tools, inflated the raft, attached the raft to my life jacket, got in my pack raft, and started rowing to shore with nothing but the wind through the trees.
